claim: The Calcaterra, Kaal, and Andrei 2018 framework satisfied manipulation resistance, autonomous operation, and computational tractability, but struggled with capturing nuanced quality, attributing value across cumulative contributions, and incentivizing knowledge sharing; existing frameworks achieve at most two or three of the six properties at once.
